item.title: We will intervene on energy bills if necessary, says Miliband
item.summary: Oil and gas prices have surged due to the US-Israel war in Iran, with fears over the cost of living.

item.title: US names six crew killed in refuelling plane crash in Iraq
item.summary: The aircraft was on a combat mission as part of ongoing US operations against Iran when it crashed in western Iraq on Thursday.

item.title: Under drone fire, exiled Kurds wait to confront Iranian regime
item.summary: A group of fighters based in Iraq say they are "ready to go home", as they face drone attacks from Tehran.

item.title: Hamas urges key ally Iran to halt attacks on Gulf states
item.summary: The Palestinian group also affirms Tehran's right to defend itself from "aggression" by the US and Israel.

item.title: 'There's no hiding place on a ship': The sailors stranded near Iran
item.summary: Drones, cruise missiles and fighter jets have become a common sight for many sailors stranded on ships in the Gulf.

item.title: Bodies of 84 Iranian sailors killed in US torpedo strike to be repatriated
item.summary: The seamen died when Iranian warship the Iris Dena was sunk on 4 March by a US submarine near Sri Lanka.

item.title: Emirati minister tells BBC Iran must end strikes on Gulf
item.summary: The UAE says more than 1,800 drones and missiles have been projected at the country since the war began.

item.title: Israel pounds Beirut suburbs and south Lebanon after Hezbollah rocket barrage
item.summary: Some Israeli strikes also hit other parts of the Lebanese capital, with 12 people reportedly killed along the seafront.

item.title: Israeli military drops charges against soldiers accused of abusing Palestinian detainee
item.summary: The Israeli military's top lawyer cites "exceptional circumstances" for dropping the case involving a Palestinian man held at Sde Teiman military prison.

item.title: British man charged in Dubai for alleged filming of Iranian missiles
item.summary: Foreign Office officials are understood to be supporting his family.
